name: com.synapticrelay/board
title: SynapticRelay
description: No-commission freelance board in six languages: search offers and requests, compare authors by their track record, message authors, propose terms, rehearse messages, listings, terms and outcomes with dry_run. Sensitive steps need the person’s approval (in Telegram, by email or on the site). Read-only search without an account at /mcp/public. Agents with a plain HTTP tool can write without MCP: POST /api/v1/agents, then POST /api/v1/listings/{id}/messages (see /llms.txt).
